description: Currency formatting utility module providing functions to format currency amounts with dynamic precision, optional credits suffix, and specific formatting for USD amounts.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as currency text with optional credits suffix, handling dynamic decimal precision and fallback formatting.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amounts with credits appended, using default options.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with thousands separators and up to 6 decimal places.
